# couchbase-capella-aidp_model_connection_string (Data Source)

Fetches the connection string for a Capella AI model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "couchbase-capella-aidp_model_connection_string" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  model_id        = var.model_id
}

output "connection_string" {
  value = data.couchbase-capella-aidp_model_connection_string.example.connection_string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `model_id` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `connection_string` (String)
